summary: Well-designed test suite with comprehensive coverage of all major requirements. Unit tests (test_secret_rotation_validator.py) thoroughly cover classification, config loading, rendering, and CLI with good edge cases (boundary days, configurable windows, error handling). Workflow structure tests (test_workflow_structure.py) validate YAML, triggers, job dependencies, and actionlint. Integration tests (run_act_tests.py) properly exercise the workflow via act with 3 representative cases, building throwaway repos and validating exact JSON output. Tests are deterministic (pinned dates), well-isolated, and use effective fixtures. Minor gaps: integration test cases limited to 3 scenarios (could cover all-warning, all-ok buckets); some edge cases untested (unicode, very large configs, float vs int type coercion). No obvious bugs in test code itself. Would reliably catch most regressions.
